scripts.build: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('frontend')) { require('child_process').execSync('cd frontend && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { require('child_process').execSync('npx vite build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
